components.gap: The source Remark after Theorem 5 (p.91) is reproduced only in part. The handbook (body 225-235, annex 436-454) proves only the upper bound E_F psi^2/d_F^2 <= 1/alpha. It does not state or prove that (psi0,F0) is a saddlepoint of V(psi,F): it never shows V(psi0,F0)=1/alpha, or V(eta,F0)>=V(psi0,F0) for competing scores. It also omits the source's two derivative identities. One is the uniformly-continuous-psi0' case, where -lambda_F'(0)=int psi0' dF and V=K^{-1} for all F. The other is the discontinuous case, where that identity holds for F in C_1.
